text: S596 will use one read-only GetPatternLineInfo query on the saved S595 pre-export periodic-SPLINE scene and compare its output against pinned source geometry. This is a distinct input representation from S580, which used a line-based fixture; it makes no new DXF exchange and does not assume the API assigns CUT/SEW semantics or importer-stage causation. All V03 gates remain unchanged.
